integrity: Exact rational boundary ranks, stabilizer actions and all 192 character-table rows are independently reproducible from the included standalone verifier; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational order-192 action on magnitude homology bidegree (3,4) is classified; total dimension 144 was published by Gu (2018). Integral lattices, torsion, other bidegrees and definitive publication priority remain undetermined.
title: Signed nonedge-orbit decomposition of Shrikhande magnitude homology
